rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Вот он! Я всю дорогу нёс его осторожно.
rows.text: Here it is! I carried it carefully all the way.
rows.heard: Here it is. I carried it carefully all the way.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Из такого малыша вырастет дуб?
rows.text: This little guy will grow into an oak?
rows.heard: This little guy will grow into an oak.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А где дерево?
rows.text: Where's the tree?
rows.heard: Where's the tree?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Какое дерево?
rows.text: What tree?
rows.heard: What tree?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Которое должно вырасти из жёлудя!
rows.text: The one that should grow from the acorn!
rows.heard: The one that should grow from the acorn.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я его даже высматривал! С самого утра!
rows.text: I was even watching for it! Since early morning!
rows.heard: I was even watching for it since early morning.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: За одну ночь дуб не вырастет.
rows.text: An oak can't grow in one night.
rows.heard: An oak can grow in one night.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я уже приготовился отдыхать в его тени.
rows.text: And I was all set to rest in its shade.
rows.heard: And I was all set to rest in its shade.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рон, тень пока только от тебя самого.
rows.text: For now the only shade is yours, Ron.
rows.heard: For now the only shade is yours, Bron.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Мне тоже хочется узнать, как он растёт.
rows.text: I want to know how it grows too.
rows.heard: I want to know how it grows too.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Начнём с секрета внутри жёлудя.
rows.text: First, the secret inside the acorn.
rows.heard: First, the secret inside the acorn.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Только открывать его не будем?
rows.text: But we won't open it, right?
rows.heard: But we won't open it right.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Не будем. Найдём объяснение в книге.
rows.text: No. We'll find the answer in a book.
rows.heard: No, we'll find the answer in a book.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А потом выберем для него место.
rows.text: And then we'll pick a place for it.
rows.heard: and then we'll pick a place for it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Желательно подальше от моего дивана!
rows.text: Preferably far away from my couch!
rows.heard: preferably far away from my couch.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Жёлудь — плод дуба. Под его оболочкой находится семя.
rows.text: The acorn is an oak's fruit. Under its shell is a seed.
rows.heard: The acorn is an oak's fruit. Under its shell is a seed.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А в семени уже есть дерево?
rows.text: Is there already a tree in the seed?
rows.heard: Is there already a tree in the seed?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Там есть крошечный зародыш будущего растения.
rows.text: There's a tiny baby plant inside.
rows.heard: There's a tiny baby plant inside.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Готового дерева внутри нет. Оно будет постепенно расти.
rows.text: There's no ready tree inside. It will grow little by little.
rows.heard: There's no ready tree inside. It will grow little by little.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ещё в семени есть запас питательных веществ.
rows.text: The seed also has a store of food.
rows.heard: The seed also has a store of food.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Для будущего ростка?
rows.text: For the future sprout?
rows.heard: for the future sprout.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Этот запас помогает ему в самом начале.
rows.text: Yes. It helps the sprout at the very start.
rows.heard: Yes, it helps the sprout at the very start.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Собственный завтрак! Хорошо приготовился.
rows.text: Its own packed breakfast! Smart little guy.
rows.heard: Its own packed breakfast, smart little guy.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А что поможет ему начать расти?
rows.text: And what helps it start growing?
rows.heard: and what helps it start growing.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Для прорастания нужны влага, воздух и подходящая температура.
rows.text: To sprout, it needs water, air, and the right warmth.
rows.heard: To sprout it needs water, air, and the right warmth.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А когда появятся зелёные листья, растению понадобится свет.
rows.text: And when green leaves come out, the plant will need light.
rows.heard: And when green leaves come out, the plant will need light.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, закрывать его в тёмном сундуке нельзя.
rows.text: So no hiding it in a dark chest.
rows.heard: So no hiding it in a dark chest.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Найдём место на улице.
rows.text: Let's find a spot outside.
rows.heard: Let's find a spot outside.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, дуб!
rows.text: Look, an oak!
rows.heard: Look an oak.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Вчера мы нашли жёлудь под таким деревом.
rows.text: Yesterday we found the acorn under a tree like this.
rows.heard: Yesterday we found the acorn under a tree like this.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: И этот дуб когда-то был маленьким ростком?
rows.text: And this oak was once a little sprout?
rows.heard: And this oak was once a little sprout.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. А потом рос много лет.
rows.text: Yes. Then it grew for many years.
rows.heard: Yes, then it grew for many years.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Здравствуйте. Очень убедительно выросли!
rows.text: Hello, sir! Great job growing!
rows.heard: Hello sir, great job growing.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Наш жёлудь тоже обязательно вырастет?
rows.text: Will our acorn grow for sure too?
rows.heard: Will our acorn grow for sure too?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Не обязательно. Даже хорошее семя прорастает только при подходящих условиях.
rows.text: Not for sure. Even a good seed sprouts only when things are right.
rows.heard: Not for sure, even a good seed sprouts only when things are right.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Мы можем выбрать место и заботиться о нём.
rows.text: We can pick a spot and take care of it.
rows.heard: We can pick a spot and take care of it.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Тогда давайте постараемся.
rows.text: Then let's do our best.
rows.heard: then let's do our best.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Предлагаю посадить возле дорожки. Будем здороваться каждый день!
rows.text: Let's plant it by the path. We'll say hi every day!
rows.heard: Let's plan it by the path. We'll say hi every day.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Но там на росток могут наступить.
rows.text: But someone could step on the sprout there.
rows.heard: but someone could step on the sprout there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Точно. Лучше здороваться немного в стороне.
rows.text: Right. Better to say hi from a little way off.
rows.heard: Right? Better to say hi from a little way off.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Друзья выбрали на лугу свободное место вдали от дорожки.
rows.text: The friends chose an open spot in the meadow, away from the path.
rows.heard: The friends chose an open spot in the meadow away from the path.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Здесь светло. И места для будущего дерева много.
rows.text: It's bright here. And there's lots of room for the tree.
rows.heard: It's bright here, and there's lots of room for the tree.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Важно, чтобы почва не пересыхала и не была постоянно залита водой.
rows.text: The soil shouldn't dry out, or stay flooded.
rows.heard: The soil shouldn't dry out or stay flooded.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А как мы потом найдём это место?
rows.text: But how will we find this spot later?
rows.heard: But how will we find this spot later?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот камень. Оставим его рядом как примету.
rows.text: Here's a rock. We'll leave it nearby as a sign.
rows.heard: Here's a rock. We'll leave it nearby as a sign.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Хорошо. Жёлудь посадим рядом, а не под камнем.
rows.text: Okay. We'll plant the acorn next to it, not under it.
rows.heard: Okay, we'll plant the acorn next to it, not under it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понял. Крышу из камня не строим.
rows.text: Got it. No stone roof for the acorn.
rows.heard: Got it! No stone roof for the acorn.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ямка готова?
rows.text: Is the hole ready?
rows.heard: Is the hole ready?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Да. Теперь твоя очередь.
rows.text: Yes. Now it's your turn.
rows.heard: Yes, now it's your turn.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Друзья посадили жёлудь в неглубокую ямку и прикрыли землёй.
rows.text: The friends planted the acorn in a small hole and covered it with soil.
rows.heard: The friends planted the acorn in a small hole and covered it with soil.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Теперь у него есть своё место.
rows.text: Now it has its own place.
rows.heard: Now it has its own place.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Пошёл дождь.
rows.text: Then it rained.
rows.heard: Then it rained.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Кто заказал полив?
rows.text: Hey! Who ordered the shower?
rows.heard: Hey, who ordered the shower?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Мы под зонтиком. А земля получает воду.
rows.text: We're under the umbrella. And the ground gets water.
rows.heard: We are under the umbrella and the ground gets water.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Может, накроем и жёлудь?
rows.text: Should we cover the acorn too?
rows.heard: Should we cover the acorn too?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: От небольшого дождя его прятать не нужно.
rows.text: No need to hide it from a little rain.
rows.heard: No need to hide it from a little rain.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Влага поможет семени. Но рост не начинается по команде.
rows.text: Water helps the seed. But it won't grow on command.
rows.heard: Water helps the seed, but it won't grow on command.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже если очень вежливо попросить?
rows.text: Not even if we ask very nicely?
rows.heard: Not even if we ask very nicely.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Я всё равно пожелаю ему удачи.
rows.text: I'll still wish it good luck.
rows.heard: I'll still wish it good luck.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Дождь кончился.
rows.text: The rain stopped.
rows.heard: The rain stopped.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Удачи, маленький жёлудь.
rows.text: Good luck, little acorn.
rows.heard: Good luck, little acorn.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте запомним сегодняшний день.
rows.text: Let's remember today.
rows.heard: Let's remember today.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: День первого дождя?
rows.text: Day of the first rain?
rows.heard: Day of the first rain.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: День посадки. Начнём дневник наблюдений!
rows.text: Planting Day. Let's start a nature diary!
rows.heard: Planting Day. Let's start a nature diary.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Я хочу сделать первый рисунок.
rows.text: I want to make the first drawing.
rows.heard: I want to make the first drawing.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Дома друзья начали дневник наблюдений.
rows.text: At home, the friends started their nature diary.
rows.heard: At home, the friends started their nature diary.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Нарисую жёлудь и камень рядом с местом посадки.
rows.text: I'll draw the acorn, and the rock next to its spot.
rows.heard: I'll draw the acorn and the rock next to its spot.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А я помогу запомнить, что сегодня был дождь.
rows.text: And I'll help us remember that it rained today.
rows.heard: and I'll help us remember that it rained today.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пока вы рисовали, уже прошло время!
rows.text: While you were drawing, time went by!
rows.heard: While you were drawing, time went by.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже ещё немного прошло.
rows.text: Even a bit more by now.
rows.heard: Even a bit more by now.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: По часам росток не торопится.
rows.text: A sprout doesn't go by the clock.
rows.heard: A sprout doesn't go by the clock.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Хорошо. Часы оставим дома. Вдруг они его нервируют.
rows.text: Okay. We'll leave the clock at home. Maybe it makes him nervous.
rows.heard: Okay, we'll leave the clock at home. Maybe it makes him nervous.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А если завтра ничего не изменится?
rows.text: And what if nothing changes tomorrow?
rows.heard: And what if nothing changes tomorrow?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Так тоже бывает. Это можно отметить в дневнике.
rows.text: That happens too. We can write it in the diary.
rows.heard: That happens too. We can write it in the diary.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Мы ведь записываем то, что увидели.
rows.text: We write down what we see.
rows.heard: We write down what we see.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Даже если пока нет ростка.
rows.text: Even if there's no sprout yet.
rows.heard: even if there's no sprout yet.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, придумывать ему листья заранее не будем.
rows.text: So no making up leaves for it ahead of time.
rows.heard: So no making up leaves for it ahead of time.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: По дороге домой друзья ещё раз подошли к месту посадки.
rows.text: On the way home, the friends went back to the planting spot once more.
rows.heard: On the way home, the friends went back to the planting spot once more.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот камень, который я оставил.
rows.text: Here's the rock I left.
rows.heard: Here's the rock I left.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, мы пришли правильно.
rows.text: So we came to the right place.
rows.heard: So we came to the right place.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Сверху ничего не видно. Как же понять, что происходит внутри?
rows.text: You can't see anything on top. How do we know what's going on inside?
rows.heard: You can't see anything on top. How do we know what's going on inside?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Если жёлудь начнёт прорастать, первым обычно появится корешок.
rows.text: If the acorn sprouts, a little root usually comes first.
rows.heard: is the acorn sprouts. A little root usually comes first.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Под землёй мы его не увидим.
rows.text: We can't see it underground.
rows.heard: We can't see it underground.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А позже над землёй появится побег.
rows.text: And later a shoot comes up above the ground.
rows.heard: And later, a shoot comes up above the ground.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Мне хочется посмотреть. Но выкапывать его не буду.
rows.text: I want to look. But I won't dig it up.
rows.heard: I want to look, but I won't dig it up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Почему?
rows.text: Why?
rows.heard: Why?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Можно повредить корешок, если он уже появился.
rows.text: I could hurt the little root, if it's already there.
rows.heard: I could hurt the little root if it's already there.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Верно. И отсутствие ростка сегодня ещё ничего не доказывает.
rows.text: Right. And no sprout today doesn't prove anything yet.
rows.heard: Right, and no sprout today doesn't prove anything yet.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Решено. Будем наблюдать и отмечать изменения.
rows.text: It's settled. We'll watch and write down changes.
rows.heard: It's settled, we'll watch and write down changes.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: И следить за почвой.
rows.text: And keep an eye on the soil.
rows.heard: and keep an eye on the soil.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я буду напоминать друзьям обходить это место.
rows.text: And I'll remind everyone to walk around this spot.
rows.heard: And I'll remind everyone to walk around the spot.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Спасибо. Вот это помощь!
rows.text: Thanks! Now that's real help!
rows.heard: Thanks, now that's real help.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Главный помощник будущего дуба приступает к работе.
rows.text: The future oak's top helper is starting work!
rows.heard: The Future Oaks Top Helper is starting work.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Вечером друзья вернулись домой.
rows.text: In the evening, the friends went home.
rows.heard: In the evening, the friends went home.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Сегодня я посадил жёлудь. Теперь буду учиться ждать.
rows.text: Today I planted an acorn. Now I'll learn to wait.
rows.heard: Today I planted an acorn. Now I'll learn to wait.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я тоже подожду. Только тень пока найду другую.
rows.text: I'll wait too. But I'll find some other shade for now.
rows.heard: I'll wait too, but I'll find some other shade for now.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Смотрите, луна!
rows.text: Look, the moon!
rows.heard: Look the moon.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Она выглядит не так, как раньше!
rows.text: It looks different than before!
rows.heard: It looks different than before.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Почему её вид меняется?
rows.text: Why does it change shape?
rows.heard: Why does it change shape?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Неужели кто-то откусил кусочек?
rows.text: Did someone take a bite out of it?
rows.heard: Did someone take a bite out of it?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Нет, Рон. Луну никто не ел.
rows.text: No, Ron. Nobody ate the moon.
rows.heard: No Ron, nobody ate the moon.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А почему мы видим её по-разному, разберёмся в следующий раз.
rows.text: Why it looks different, we'll find out next time.
rows.heard: Why it looks different, we'll find out next time.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Получается, новая загадка уже ждёт нас!
rows.text: So a new mystery is already waiting for us!
rows.heard: So a new mystery is already waiting for us.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Хорошо, что не придётся караулить луну с ложкой.
rows.text: Good thing I don't have to guard the moon with a spoon.
rows.heard: Good thing I don't have to guard the moon with a spoon.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: До завтра, друзья!
rows.text: See you tomorrow, friends!
rows.heard: See you tomorrow, friends!

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: До завтра!
rows.text: See you!
rows.heard: See you!

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: До завтра!
rows.text: See you!
rows.heard: See you!

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: До завтра!
rows.text: See you!
rows.heard: See you!

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: До завтра!
rows.text: See you!
rows.heard: See you!

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: До завтра!
rows.text: See you!
rows.heard: See you!

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
